data.body:
[P3] Exclude completed operations from the replay-start description

Operations that started in an earlier invocation do not necessarily receive this hook on replay. Completed steps return before `onOperationStart`, and completed waits can emit `onOperationEnd` without a start hook in that invocation. A plugin relying on this description to reconstruct its operation state would therefore miss records. Limit the replay claim to unfinished operations that resume, and direct authors to `InvocationInfo.operations` for already-completed operations.
